thread:
katie: final pre-cutover check — change window starts 11:00 PT, rolling canary then ramp. quick items: pin config, smoke commands, rollback lane. please ack in 10m if you’re good. release notes: https://releases.redwood.dev/rwd-3/2026-03-20

maria: linked release notes above. DB migration is a no-op if already applied. note about config: feature.flag.new_routing = on only for canary group.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout job created by @katie. canary job id: canary-3499. initial traffic split 5% -> gpu-pool-3. warming pods: 4/4.

sanjay: infra oncall here — alert thresholds set (5xx > 1% over 2m) and APM alerting for p95 latency > 200ms. watching logs.

oliver: devex confirm: client SDK pinned to 2.3.1 in release branch and npm tags updated. docs/upgrade checklist pushed to the release PR.

katie: @maria @sanjay ack for go/no-go pls. if both ack we start canary at T+0 (11:00).

maria: ack :thumbsup: — business stakeholders notified, monitoring dashboard shared with them.

sanjay: ack — infra green. cpu/gpu capacity headroom checked.

gaurav: quick smoke run against canary endpoint (ran 10:58 PT):
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-3","prompt":"smoke"}' | jq -r '.choices[0].text'
```
latency ~85ms, no 500s seen in 2m window.

deploy-bot: canary-3499: 5% live for 5m, no regressions observed. next scheduled step: ramp to 25% at +15m if no alerts.

anne: rollback reminder — immediate rollback criteria: any sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 5m OR p95 > 300ms for 5m. rollback plan: pin traffic back to rwd-2.9 and scale down rwd-3. run `deployctl rollback --to rwd-2.9 --cutover` and notify #incidents.

katie: pinning action: deploy-bot set pinned_version=rwd-3@2026-03-20T10:58Z for this change window. release notes and postmortem template linked in the thread. starting canary at 11:00. if you see anything odd, post here and page oncall.

maria: one more note — dataflow job backfill scheduled for 03:30 PT tomorrow; not in this window but FYI.

oliver: leaving a short checklist copy for deploy script: `smoke.sh && infra-checks.sh && deployctl rollout canary --id canary-3499`.

katie: thanks everyone. I'll leave this channel open during the ramp. :coffee:
